texts.7a8a4deb21a8: The principal objectives of this study are three fold 1.to identify genetic and epidemiological factors that are associated with increased risk of ovarian cancer 2.to identify novel biomarkers for early diagnosis, prediction of prognosis and monitoring of recurrence of ovarian cancer 3. to investigate the potential for expedited diagnosis of ovarian cancer via early symptom recognition
